title: SiriusXM and Pandora Present Keith Urban’s Holiday Concert in NYC
summary: Keith Urban is taking the stage in New York City's Hammerstein Ballroom for an exclusive holiday performance airing on SiriusXM and Pandora.
body_markdown:
Keith Urban is getting festive with an exclusive SiriusXM and Pandora concert.


[The Highway Country’s next generation Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogKeithUrbanSiriusXMPandoraPresents)


The country superstar is taking the stage at New York City’s Hammerstein Ballroom on December 8, where he will perform a string of hits including “Blue Ain’t Your Color,” “Somebody Like You,” and “The Fighter.” Bringing the cheer, Keith will also sing some fan favorite holiday hits.


For fans who can’t make it, the full concert will air on SiriusXM’s The Highway (Ch. 56) on December 18 at 8pm ET and will be available on the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogKeithUrbanSiriusXMPandoraPresents) afterward.


### Enter for a Chance to Win Tickets to SiriusXM and Pandora Present Keith Urban in NYC


Want a chance to get into the holiday spirit with Keith Urban during the exclusive concert hosted by SiriusXM and Pandora?


SiriusXM subscribers and fans can enter for a chance to win a pair of tickets to the show[here.](https://siriusxmpandorapresentkeithurban.splashthat.com/PR)


Those outside of New York City can enter for a chance to win a VIP trip to the concert[here.](https://www.siriusxm.com/keithurbanholidayPR)


### Listen to SiriusXM and Pandora Present Keith Urban


Hear the concert on The Highway (Ch. 56)


- **Friday, December 18:** 8pm ET and stream it any time on the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogKeithUrbanSiriusXMPandoraPresents) .


### The Highway on SiriusXM


Discover the next generation of country superstars on The Highway – where breakthrough Highway Finds meet brand new music from country’s biggest hitmakers. Hosted weekdays by Cody Alan, Macie Banks, Buzz Brainard and Ania Hammar from the heart of Broadway in downtown Nashville, Tennessee.
